supported_scope: If the full-torus theorem and equality of cocharacter/full-charge ideals hold with the same coefficient maps and gradings, their composition gives both coefficient surjectivities, equal kernels, and the canonical equivariant Hikita isomorphism.
The source distinguishes equality of coefficient kernels in R from equality of fixed-scheme ideals inside A_F.
The assembly preserves actual quotient ideals, nilpotents, arbitrary regular characters, commuting flavor, and the empty case.
The conclusion is for finite-quiver product-GL commutative cohomological gauge theories, not arbitrary reductive groups or quantized/K-theoretic variants.
remaining_gaps: The BFN/minuscule/Laurent geometric and grading interfaces remain conditional beyond the abstract algebra proof.
Kernel inclusion still depends on finite correspondence, equivariant vanishing-cycle, and Kirwan interfaces.
The geometric cut application and determinant counting/moment-level comparison remain separate prerequisites.
Flavor base change, prequotient localization, stability comparison, and homogeneous descent require the independently unaccepted source geometric inputs.
Cocharacter equality requires the polynomial Hall-map degeneration, root support, and moment-block/complement argument.
The old local finite and Lean certificates do not certify the full theorem or the entire manuscript.
The old source reference is a symlink, so byte agreement does not independently freeze historical manuscript content.
